modes.CREATE_NEW: B transaction atomically creates Course (if absent) plus reserved operation; then A provisions by stable link_key; B finalizes
modes.ADOPT_EXISTING: Course already exists UNLINKED; operator selects existing A shell; dry-run and exact stable ref verification, B reserves, no A create, B finalizes

critical_invariants: same link_key and A external key in final binding
same idempotency key with mismatched canonical body -> HTTP 409
I persistence uses A/B service APIs only
read-after-write verification of both services before ACTIVE
retry_rules: Use B durable operation log and A create-op journal; if status unknown, re-read both by op ID, never blindly re-create; retry with exponential backoff+max attempts, quarantine conflicts; no exactly-once promise.
cutover: Scoped policy for new shell CREATE actions (STANDALONE→FREEZE→MANAGED) is applied via pre-released A admin API only after S4 dry-run complete and Owner permission; existing A read/search/repair stays available. On failure freeze new writes; keep owner-specific UIs read-only as needed. Rollback cannot erase existing A/B data.
